description: Read-only cost preview. It only calculates the credit cost on Vidaro's own servers: it never starts a job, never spends credits, and never contacts external AI providers. Same validation and credit math as a real generation. When to use: always immediately before any generate_* call; tell the user the number of credits and pass max_credits accordingly. Returns: estimated credit cost and breakdown fields. motion_control uses the motion clip length; video_edit uses source length; video_extend uses source plus extension. Genjutsu Explore: pass template_slug. Does not enqueue jobs.
